arguments.command:
git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
feat: show what pi does in the workflow log

The log showed the storage plumbing (each push, each snapshot) and almost
nothing of the agent's work. Now, as entries are stored:

- 💬 for a model's text (first line; the full text in a group),
- 🔧 when a tool call starts (the tool and its main argument),
- ↳ ✓/✗ when it ends, with its duration and line count, and its arguments
  and the last 30 lines of output in a group,
- ▶ for each request pi gets, and ✅/❌ for each reply, with totals:
  model responses, tool calls, time, tokens, and cost.

The setup goes in a collapsed Setup group with a one-line model summary.
The thread and how to read it with git come first, in a 🧵 group, instead
of after the last push. Pushes and snapshots are debug messages, and the
run ends with the thread's tip.

Refs #46
EOF
timeout 120 git push -q -u origin feat/46-readable-logs 2>&1 | tail -1
timeout 120 gh pr create --title "feat: show what pi does in the workflow log" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Implements the readable action logs from #46.

## Before
```
Running pi agent for: <the whole multi-line task>
  Installing pi extensions: github:cv/pit#v0.35.1
  … 5 more setup lines …
  refs/pi/threads/45: fetched fe91da2
  refs/pi/worktrees/45: new on origin
  Thread refs/pi/threads/45: since 2026-11-12T07:01:35.000Z
  refs/pi/threads/45: pushed a1982f3
  Saved the working tree as 5f5a17d on refs/pi/worktrees/45
  … one push line per model response and tool result …
▸ How to read refs/pi/threads/45 with git        (only at the very end)
```

## After
```
▸ Setup
🤖 nvidia/aws/anthropic/bedrock-claude-opus-5-5 · extensions: pit (typescript)
▸ 🧵 Thread refs/pi/threads/46: continuing, started 2026-11-12 07:11 UTC
▶ Request from @cv (https://github.com/…#issuecomment-…): Ready to write a PR?
💬 I'll look at the existing sessions first.
🔧 bash: git log --oneline -5
▸   ↳ ✓ 0.1s · 5 lines
🔧 edit: src/run.ts (2 edits)
▸   ↳ ✓ 0.0s · 1 line
▸ 💬 I opened PR #48, which …
✅ Replied: https://github.com/…#issuecomment-… (24 model responses · 23 tool calls · 6m40s · 2.1M tokens in, 31k out)
🧵 refs/pi/threads/46 is at 4325d9a
```

## Why one line per step, not one group per turn
The existing threads show that a run usually handles 1 request (sometimes 2–3), and each request takes 1–92 model responses with about one tool call each. A group per turn would hide most of the run behind one fold. So each step is one line that you can read while the run is going:
- `🔧` is printed when a tool call **starts**, so you can see what a long `npm test` is doing.
- When the call ends, `↳ ✓`/`↳ ✗ failed` is printed as a collapsed group with the arguments and the last 30 lines of output.
- If one response makes several calls, the `↳` lines name their calls.

## Changes
- `src/activity.ts` (new) formats stored entries (`pi.assistant`, `pi.tool-result`) and counts responses, tool calls, failures, tokens, and cost for each reply.
- `Thread` gets an `onEntries` option. It comes from GitStorage's `onCommit`, or from a `MemoryStorage` subclass for one-off prompts.
- `run.ts`:
  - The setup is in a collapsed `Setup` group, followed by a one-line model and extensions summary.
  - The `🧵 Thread` group with the git commands now comes at the **start** of the run, as asked on #46. The job summary is unchanged.
  - Each request gets a `▶` line, each reply a `✅`/`❌` line with totals, and the run ends with the thread's tip.
- Pushes, fetches, and working-tree snapshots are now `core.debug` messages. They show with step debug logging. `Log` gets an optional `debug`.
- Docs: a new "The workflow log" section in `how-it-works.md`, plus updates in `threads.md` and `security.md` (tool output is now in the log).

`npm run check` passes (383 tests).
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -1
